items: Capture — Capture a Territory / Advance Front Line, if applicable.
Draw — Draw 1 card.
Opening — You may take your Action here.
Movement — Advance, Hold, or Fall Back. Resolve any battle immediately.
Denouement — If you did not take your Action in Opening, you may take it here.
Cleanup — Resolve end-of-turn effects and discard down to your Hand limit.

blocks.text: You take 1 Action total per turn, during either Opening or Denouement. Each phase permits at most 1 Action, even when you gain Additional Actions.
Resolve movement one Position at a time. When movement initiates a battle, that movement sequence ends and any unused movement from it is lost.

When movement enters the opponent's Position, it initiates a battle and immediately enters Onset. Establish the attacker, defender, contested Position, and attacker's previous Position. If the battle proceeds, resolve remaining Onset effects before setting Gambits.

items: Onset
Set Gambits.
Set Hands aside and form 3-card Reserves.
Reveal Gambits.
Choose Tactics.
Reveal Tactics.
Determine the Outcome.
Resolve the Aftermath.

blocks.text: Higher battle total wins. Defensive Edge wins ties. Otherwise, each player rolls 1 unmodified die; higher roll wins; reroll ties.

items: Losing attacker → returns to the Position they entered from.
Losing defender → retreats 1 Position toward their own end.
Winning attacker → takes the contested Position.
Winning defender → remains there.

blocks.text: Gambits → Graveyard. Tactics and cards remaining in Reserve → Discard Pile.

During Onset, withdrawal ends the battle sequence: no Gambits, battle result, or Aftermath. After Onset has completed and the battle proceeds to Gambits, a later withdrawal finishes the remaining non-result Aftermath steps and clears committed battle cards using their standard destinations.
Front Line = your continuous line of controlled Territories from your own end.

At the start of your turn, if you occupy an opponent's Territory, rotate that Territory card to face you to capture it. If doing so would create a non-continuous line of controlled Territories, instead capture the next Territory past your Front Line: Advance Front Line 1.
Capture changes control of at most 1 Territory per turn. Occupation alone does not change control.
Capture the Territory at the opponent's end, or force the opponent to make a Last Stand and win the resulting battle.

A Last Stand can be forced while you occupy the final Territory, before you capture it. After the opponent retreats beyond their end, force them to make a Last Stand with a new legal Advance beyond the Gauntlet.
The defender has Defensive Edge.

rows: No Action · Before dice after refused Terms

blocks.text: During Onset, after the attacker, defender, contested Position, and attacker's previous Position are established and before other pre-Gambit effects, choose an eligible Proposal and stake its required Influence by moving your tracker down the listed amount. Present the Proposal to the opponent. They accept or refuse.
The attacker has the first opportunity to offer Terms. If the attacker passes, the defender may offer. Once either player offers Terms, the other may not offer Terms in that battle sequence.

items: Apply the Proposal's Accepted effect.
Return the Stake.
Discard any previously imposed Sanctions.
If unratified, flip the Proposal to its Treaty Article side and gain 1 Influence.
End the battle sequence during Onset: no battle is fought, no Gambits are set, and there is no winner, loser, or Aftermath.
Apply the Proposal's Refused effect.
You may impose Sanctions (once per refused Terms).
Continue Onset; if the battle proceeds, continue to Gambits.
Before dice are rolled, the Diplomat may use Leverage.

blocks.label: Diplomat wins
blocks.text: Return the Stake. If the Proposal is unratified, ratify it and gain 2 Influence.

blocks.label: Diplomat loses
blocks.text: Lose the Stake. The Proposal is not ratified.

blocks.label: No winner / Withdrawal
blocks.text: Return the Stake. The Proposal is not ratified.
After Terms are refused, before dice are rolled, spend available Influence to increase the Diplomat's battle total.
1 Influence
3 Influence
6 Influence
10 Influence
Staked Influence cannot be spent as Leverage.
A ratified Proposal may be offered again. Ratification and its Influence reward occur only once.
After the Capture step at the start of your turn, if 6 different Proposals are ratified, you win.
Capital limit = Territories you control + total card value in your Treasury.
Capital may exceed the limit temporarily. At the end of every turn, reduce Capital to the current limit if necessary.
During Denouement, spend 1 Action to place a card from your Hand face up in your Treasury. Its value increases your Capital limit.
After Capture at the start of your turn, gain 1 Capital per Deed you own.
After Capture, if your Treasury value is greater than the number of Territories you control, you may take one Action in Opening and one Action in Denouement that turn.
At least one Action must be spent on a Faction Feature marked 1 Action.
During Denouement, spend 1 Action and pay the Deed's full cost.

blocks.label: Base cost
blocks.text: min(Deeds you own + 1, 6)
Minimum cost: 1 Capital.
If making several purchases, recalculate after each purchase.
During Denouement, spend 1 Action, discard 1 card from Hand, and roll:

rows: Gain Capital equal to card value

blocks.text: Before dice are rolled, spend Capital to increase your battle total.
1 Capital
3 Capital
6 Capital
10 Capital
If you own the Deeds to every Territory currently in the Gauntlet, you win immediately.
During Denouement, spend 1 Action to place an eligible Intelligence card from Hand face down as your Active Mission.

items: Choose a card with a printed Mission requirement.
The Mission / Special Operation slot holds one card.
A Mission becomes eligible to complete starting on a later turn.

blocks.text: During Denouement, if its requirement is satisfied, spend 1 Action to reveal and complete the Active Mission:

items: Increment Operation Progress by 1.
Gain Intel equal to the card's value.
Put the Mission in your Discard Pile.

blocks.text: Completion still requires the Denouement Action above after the requirement is satisfied.

blocks.label: Abort
blocks.text: During Denouement, spend 1 Action, reveal the Active Mission, and spend Intel equal to its value. Put it in your Discard Pile.

blocks.label: Fail
blocks.text: If a rule, effect, or continuing requirement causes failure, reveal the Mission and put it in your Graveyard.
A Special Operation is ready only while your Operation Progress exceeds the number of Territories the opponent controls.
To start one, the Mission / Special Operation slot must be empty and you must have an eligible Intelligence card in Hand.
During Denouement, spend 1 Action to place the eligible card face down as your Special Operation.
It uses the card's printed Mission requirement. On completion, resolve only the Special Operation payment and win procedure below.
During Denouement, if its requirement is satisfied and readiness remains valid, spend 1 Action, reveal it, and pay:
Territories currently in the Gauntlet − card value
Minimum payment: 1 Intel. If paid, you win immediately.
If readiness is lost before completion, the Special Operation immediately fails and goes to the Graveyard.

rows: No Action · 1 Intel · Once per battle
No Action · 1 Intel per card · Once per battle
No Action · +2 Intel per removed card · Immediately after reveal
No Action · 2 Intel · Face-up opposing card

blocks.text: After the opponent sets a face-down Gambit, spend 1 Intel to reveal it. This opportunity is once per battle.
After the opponent chooses face-down Tactics, spend 1 Intel per opposing Tactic you reveal. This opportunity is once per battle and is separate from Gambit Surveillance.
Immediately after revealing a card through Surveillance, spend 2 additional Intel per card you remove.

items: Removed Gambit → owner's Hand.
Removed Tactic → owner's Reserve.
The owner may choose one eligible replacement from the same source or pass.
Replacements enter face down.

blocks.text: After a replacement, continue the current stage without another Surveillance, Interference, reveal, or response window.
If you had already made your own choice at that stage, after the opponent replaces an interfered card you may revise your choice using the information already revealed.
If an opposing effect sets or chooses a card face up, spend 2 Intel to Interfere at the same response timing.
Direct Interference spends that stage's Interference opportunity directly.
At each choice stage:

items: First player makes the relevant choice.
Second player may use Surveillance / Interference, then makes their choice.
First player may use Surveillance / Interference, then revise their own choice if allowed.
The stage closes.

blocks.text: If an effect prevents Surveillance or Interference, the Intel remains spent and the relevant once-per-battle opportunity is still used.

rows: No Action · Once per turn · Before dice
Automatic · During Ritual battle you initiated

blocks.text: During Denouement, spend 1 Action to begin one incomplete Rite and pay its beginning cost.

items: Have at most one incomplete Rite at a time.
Begin the Rites in any order.
A Rite becomes eligible to complete starting on a later turn.
Complete at most one Rite per turn.
If interrupted, reset it; paid costs remain spent.

blocks.label: 1st Rite
blocks.text: Unlock Invocation.

blocks.label: 2nd Rite
blocks.text: Unlock Transmutation.

blocks.label: 3rd Rite
blocks.text: Unlock Convergence and permission to begin the Ritual of Ascension.
Once per turn, after applying the Action, Gambit, Tactic, or Gambit/Tactic effect of an Arcane card you played, set, or chose, you may move 1 card from your Graveyard to your Discard Pile.
Once per turn, before dice are rolled in a battle involving you, you may put 1 card from Hand in your Graveyard and add its value to your battle total.
Move the card directly from Hand to Graveyard for its value; only its value applies.
After completing all three Rites, during Denouement spend 1 Action to bind:

items: 1 Arcane card from your Hand;
1 Arcane card from your Discard Pile; and
1 Arcane card from your Graveyard.

blocks.text: While the Ritual is underway, during a battle you initiated, add +1 to your battle total per card bound to the Ritual.
With all three cards bound, Convergence gives +3.
Initiate a battle while all three Ritual cards remain bound. If you win that battle, complete the Ritual and win immediately.
If you lose any battle before Ritual completion, put all three Ritual-bound cards in your Graveyard. Completed Rites remain complete, and you may begin the Ritual again later.
After a Withdrawal, the Ritual remains underway.
When a Rite or Ritual binding ends, put its bound cards in their owners' Graveyards.

rows: Automatic · First qualifying Aftermath each turn

blocks.text: Begin at 0. Maximum 4.
The first time each turn one or more opposing cards enter the Graveyard during the Aftermath of a battle involving you, gain 1 Conviction.

items: This may occur during either player's turn.
Several qualifying cards from the same battle give 1 Conviction total.

blocks.text: During the Aftermath of battles involving you, opposing Tactics go to their owner's Graveyard instead of their Discard Pile.
Gain 1 Conviction whenever an opponent:

items: plays an Arcane card for its Action effect; or
reveals an Arcane Gambit or Tactic they control.

blocks.text: Blasphemy Conviction is separate from the once-per-turn Aftermath gain. Maximum 4.
For Blasphemy, copying an Arcane card's effect counts only if the effect says the card is played or revealed.
At the beginning of the opponent's turn, after their start-of-turn Draw attempt, if they draw no cards because both their Draw Pile and Discard Pile are empty, you win immediately.
Purification checks only the opponent's start-of-turn Draw.

rows: 1 Action · Opening or Denouement · Once per turn

blocks.text: During Opening or Denouement, spend 1 Action and the listed Conviction.

rows: Choose one: put the top card of the opponent's Discard Pile in their Graveyard; or choose up to two cards there with combined value 2 or less and put them in their Graveyard.
Put one opposing Asset in its owner's Graveyard.
The opponent chooses one card from Hand and puts it in their Graveyard.
Reveal the opponent's Hand. Choose one card and put it in their Graveyard.

blocks.text: Purge is a Faction Feature, not a card play.
If one Action that turn is Purge, you may also take one Action in the other Action phase that turn.
Take at most 1 Action in each phase.
You may spend an Action on Purge once per turn.
Only a Purge taken as an Action uses the once-per-turn Action-Purge and enables the two-phase Action permission.
The top card is the most recently placed card.
After choosing cards from a Discard Pile, keep the remaining cards in the same order.
When an effect allows several cards within a combined value limit, add their printed values and choose a set whose total is within the limit.

blocks.label: Beginning cost
blocks.text: Bind one chosen card from your Graveyard face up beneath this Rite. Then bind one card from your Hand face down beneath it whose title matches at least one other card in your Deck.

blocks.label: Completion
blocks.text: On a later turn, complete this Rite after the Gambit, Tactic, or Gambit or Tactic effect of another card with the bound Hand card's title is applied during a battle.
On completion:

items: move the selected Graveyard card to your Discard Pile;
put the bound Hand card in your Graveyard;
apply the completing card normally; and
flip Rite of Echoes to its completed side.

blocks.text: If you lose a battle before completion, put both bound cards in your Graveyard and reset the Rite.

blocks.label: Beginning cost
blocks.text: Put one card from your Hand in your Graveyard.

blocks.label: Completion
blocks.text: On a later turn, complete this Rite when you win a battle without setting a Gambit or choosing a Tactic.
Using Transmutation, an Asset, Overlay, Territory, Leader ability, or card from another source does not by itself prevent completion.
If you lose a battle before completion, reset the Rite.

You may take the Begin a Rite Faction Action for Rite of Crossing during Denouement only after winning a battle that turn that made you the occupier of a Territory the opponent controlled immediately before that battle.

blocks.label: Beginning cost
blocks.text: Put one Arcane card from your Hand in your Graveyard. If you have none, reveal your Hand and move one Arcane card from your Discard Pile to your Graveyard instead.

blocks.label: Completion
blocks.text: At the start of your next turn, after the Capture step, complete this Rite if you are still the occupier or now control that Territory. Otherwise, the Rite is interrupted and resets.
